stem: Which lines from the poem best identify the source of the speaker's conflict?

options.label: F
options.text: Living in between two ways/of speaking/and hearing (lines 1–3)

options.label: G
options.text: At least we’re finally/on our way to the farm, (lines 7–8)

options.label: H
options.text: Horses of so many shades/that the colors can’t be/counted. (lines 22–24)

options.label: J
options.text: Everything looks just as wild and free/as I’ve half-remembered (lines 25–26)
